text:
Sarah - Sales: Quick update — AcmeCorp POC: procurement won't sign the DPA as-is. They've redlined subprocessors and added a 60-day data deletion window. Also asking to split the PO (PO for POC vs production). Need legal + finance guidance on signer path (they say CFO signs > $25k). Need countersign by Fri EOD.

Michael - Legal: Can you paste the exact redline? If it's only subprocessors + deletion window we can probably handle it. Is this an order form or a PO-backed purchase? CFO signature threshold matters for routing.

Sarah - Sales: Order form total if they go prod is $42k, POC PO will be $6k. They want a guaranteed 99.5% SLA during evaluation (we don't publish SLA for POC). They also asked for KMS/HSM language in the MSA. Redline excerpt: `DPA §4: Customer requires Subprocessor list + 30 days notice; DataDeletion: "within 60 days"`.

Devon - Solutions Eng: We can classify the POC as "evaluation services" and state SLA N/A. KMS is only available for Private deployments — we should flag that to Legal so we don't overpromise on hosted.

Tom - Finance: They asked net60. For PO < $10k we can usually do net30, but enterprise deals sometimes require net60 with AR approval. Splitting invoices is doable — finance prefers two line items on the order form and two invoices.

Michael - Legal: High-level: subprocessors list + 30 days notice = fine. 60-day deletion request is aggressive; propose compromise: "data deletion within 30 days, backups retained for up to 90 days for legal/compliance needs." KMS/HSM: we can't promise for hosted; offer as Private addendum. SLA: mark POC as non-production (no uptime SLA). Signer routing: keep POC signing to Sales Manager; production/billing activation > $25k requires exec/CFO sign-off. I'll draft a redline and an order form appendix.

Sarah - Sales: Can you also add a clause that production activation triggers the CFO signature if they cross the threshold? Customer already pushing to finish sign-off this week.

Michael - Legal: Yes, I'll add: `Production activation > $25,000 requires executive sign-off (CFO) and will be reflected in order form appendix.` Also adding an invoice-splitting appendix describing POC vs production billing. Uploading redline shortly.

esign_bot: Envelope created: ENV-2026-443. Recipients: (1) Sarah - Sales Manager (signer), (2) AcmeCorp CFO (approver for prod activation), (3) AcmeCorp Accounting (PO recipient). Routing set: signer -> approver -> accounting. Note: e-sign requires ID verification for transactions > $25k.

Tom - Finance: Looping in AR to review net60 for production. @Michael - can legal make the CFO signature requirement explicit in the order form so AR has a trigger?

Michael - Legal: Done — clause added and redline uploaded: https://redwood.box.com/s/acme_dpa_msaredline_v2 . Please review comments on the DPA §4 and the OrderForm Appendix.

Sarah - Sales: Thanks. I'll send the envelope to the customer and ask procurement to route PO to Accounting for net60 approval. Will push for countersign by Friday. :thumbsup:

Devon - Solutions Eng: FYI once PO for POC lands we can spin the evaluation environment. No SLA for that environment.

Tom - Finance: AR will prioritize once they receive envelope + PO.

Sarah - Sales: Received the redline link. I'll review and revert within the hour.

Michael - Legal: Ping me with any comments; I can fast-track this if AR and Sales confirm routing.
